COURT’S OR JUDGES’S ORDERS
06.02.2026 WPSS No.333 of 2026
Hon’ble Siddhartha Sah, J.
Mr. Bharat Singh, learned counsel for the
petitioner.
2. Mr. N. K. Papnoi, learned Standing 
Counsel for the State. 
3. Heard. 
4. Learned State Counsel prays for and is 
granted two weeks’ time to file counter affidavit. 
5. The present petitioner is similarly situated 
to the petitioner in WPSS No. 184 of 2026, 
wherein an interim order has been granted by the 
Coordinate Bench of this Court vide order dated 
29.01.2026. Hence, a similar interim order is 
called for.
6. List on 27.02.2026. 
7. In the meanwhile, one post of Assistant 
Teacher (Science), in Government Primary 
School in OBC Category shall be kept vacant in 
District Pithoragarh, in case the posts are not 
filled up. 
8. Urgency application and interim relief
application (IA Nos.1 & 2 of 2026) stand 
disposed of accordingly.
 (Siddhartha Sah, J.)
 Vacation Judge 
 06.02.2026
